# re:verse DS

> An AI-ready mobile banking design system in Figma (file qUknPCIey4DG3PH19e1OmD). Agents assemble screens from local components and variables, following the rules and recipes below.

## Start here
- [Agent rules](CLAUDE.md): hard rules and the build workflow
- [Persona and data](foundations/persona.md): the one person, accounts, people and numbers every screen uses
- [Figma ledger](state/figma-ledger.json): page, collection, component and example ids

## Foundations
- [Tokens](foundations/tokens.md): collections, which token for which role, spacing, radius
- [Theming](foundations/theming.md): brand themes (re:verse, Atlas), light/dark
- [Typography](foundations/typography.md): text styles and when to use them
- [Voice](foundations/voice.md): UI copy, Spirit tone of voice and the four personas (glow + voice variables)

## Components
- [Catalog](components/overview.md): every component, its synonyms and the file to read
- [Controls & feedback](components/controls.md): toggle, checkbox/radio, progress, badge, alert, empty state, search, avatar group…

## Recipes
- [Recipes index](recipes/overview.md): home feed, account, card screen, picker, send/top up (amount → confirm), Spirit chat answer

## Skills
- [build-screen](.claude/skills/build-screen/SKILL.md): one screen from a text request
- [build-flow](.claude/skills/build-flow/SKILL.md): a flow from a brief
- [audit-screen](.claude/skills/audit-screen/SKILL.md): check and fix a screen; script in `scripts/audit-screen.js`

## Optional
- [Evals](evals/rubric.md): how a screen is scored; [prompts](evals/prompts.md) to test with
- [Research](research/ai-ready-ds-research.md): how AI-ready design systems work (Russian)
